new_code_spec.q_fit_definition: Take the exact fit-standardized target tensor values used by the accepted parent loss (normally float32); promote these values to float64 for gap calculation. new_code_spec.batch_pair_universe: unordered i<j within current batch, exclude pairs with identical actual parent training-target tensor value; do not round labels anew. If different original Y collapse in parent dtype, log aggregate count and retain parent target semantics.
new_code_spec.gap_arm: select all current-batch pairs with |z_i-z_j|>=q_fit, let count be m_b; exact ties at q included
new_code_spec.uniform_matched_arm: select exactly m_b distinct pairs from full unequal-label batch universe, smallest SHA256 keys; m_b computed from same batch true fit labels, never from predictions
new_code_spec.hash_key_protocol: SHA256(UTF8("P004PAIR-v1|{task}|{split_id}|{model_seed}|{epoch_1based}|{batch_index_0based}|{min_row_index}|{max_row_index}")); order by digest bytes then row-index pair; dedicated deterministic mechanism does not advance torch/numpy/dataloader RNG

new_code_spec.total_objective: 0.5*mean((p-zY)^2) over ALL rows in batch + 0.5*mean(selected pair losses)
new_code_spec.q_interpretation: experimental pair-information selection, not an assay-noise estimate or empirically optimal threshold
new_code_spec.preregistered_no_grid: one q quantile0.5 only; coefficient0.5 fixed; no q/lambda search; no extra seeds
new_code_spec.logging: fit-only q/tie count; per-epoch aggregate pair cardinality and average label-gap summaries; loss components; no rowwise Valid or rowwise residual logs
